opportunities.title: The building blocks for a voice assistant exist
opportunities.detail: Commercial speech recognition and a synthetic voice both exist, but no major assistant understands spoken requests in this language yet.
opportunities.why: About 119 million Punjabi speakers are online today, and that should reach 155 million within five years. Ready to use: Kathbath (137 hours of transcribed speech); Shrutilipi (90 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: No published LLM benchmark results
opportunities.detail: Neither of the two multilingual benchmarks we track reports this language. Adding it would give builders and buyers a baseline.
opportunities.why: About 59 million Punjabi speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 76 million within five years. Ready to use: FLORES-200 (covers this language); Belebele (covers this language).

opportunities.title: Speech recognition makes about 48 errors per 100 words
opportunities.detail: Measured on FLEURS with a leading open model. Below about 15% is comfortably usable for dictation.
opportunities.why: About 119 million Punjabi speakers are online today, and that should reach 155 million within five years. Ready to use: Kathbath (137 hours of transcribed speech); Shrutilipi (90 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: Text recognition is offered by 2 of 3 major services
